### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building scalable Java systems, REST APIs, and microservices. Developing reliable applications with cloud, database, search, and AI-assisted technologies.
Senior Software Engineer building scalable Java systems for an enterprise software company
- Salary: $105,000 - $115,000 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, ElasticSearch, Java, JavaScript, Material UI, Microservices, MongoDB, MySQL, Next.js, Postgres, React, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Write code and contribute to the development of software applications, modules, or components
- Participate in requirements analysis, design, architecture, system integration, testing, and project management
- Test code to identify and fix bugs and ensure software quality and reliability
- Collaborate with software architects, designers, and product managers to align with project goals and timelines
- Design and build complex, scalable systems
- Lead technical discussions, make critical decisions, and drive consensus among team members
- Proficiency in Java, including Core Java (Java 11/17+), JVM internals, memory management, tuning, and concurrency/multithreading
- Experience with Spring, particularly Spring Boot
- Experience designing, building, and securing robust, scalable REST APIs
- Proficiency with relational and non-relational databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB
- Experience with Elasticsearch and search/indexing technologies
- Experience with React, Next.js, and Material UI
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT
- Familiarity with AI-directed prompt engineering for application development

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building scalable Java systems, REST APIs, and microservices. Developing reliable applications with cloud, database, search, and AI-assisted technologies.
Senior Software Engineer building scalable Java systems for an enterprise software company
Role description:
• Write code and contribute to the development of software applications, modules, or components
• Participate in requirements analysis, design, architecture, system integration, testing, and project management
• Test code to identify and fix bugs and ensure software quality and reliability
• Collaborate with software architects, designers, and product managers to align with project goals and timelines
• Design and build complex, scalable systems
• Lead technical discussions, make critical decisions, and drive consensus among team members
Role requirements:
• Proficiency in Java, including Core Java (Java 11/17+), JVM internals, memory management, tuning, and concurrency/multithreading
• Experience with Spring, particularly Spring Boot
• Experience designing, building, and securing robust, scalable REST APIs
• Proficiency with relational and non-relational databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB
• Experience with Elasticsearch and search/indexing technologies
• Experience with React, Next.js, and Material UI
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT
• Familiarity with AI-directed prompt engineering for application development
• Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent work experience
• 8+ years of experience in software development
• 3+ years as a Software Engineer focused on designing and building complex, scalable systems
• Deep understanding of software engineering principles, design patterns, algorithms, and system architecture
• Ability to lead technical discussions, make critical decisions, and drive consensus among team members
• Experience with cloud technologies and microservices architecture
• No immigration or employment-visa sponsorship is offered or provided, now or in the future
• In-person identity verification is required for employment

Cloud, ElasticSearch, Java, JavaScript, Material UI, Microservices, MongoDB, MySQL, Next.js, Postgres, React, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot
